name: Brightside Health
one_liner: Brightside Health offers online psychiatry and therapy for depression and anxiety, combining medication management with therapy for comprehensive virtual mental health treatment.
best_for: People with depression or anxiety who may benefit from both medication and therapy
Those wanting comprehensive treatment from one platform
People who prefer video appointments over in-person visits
Those with insurance looking for affordable psychiatric care
People who want ongoing care with the same provider
not_for: Those with complex conditions requiring specialized psychiatric care
Those seeking treatment for conditions beyond depression/anxiety
short_description: Online psychiatry and therapy platform specializing in depression and anxiety treatment with medication management.
long_description: Brightside Health provides virtual mental health care focused on depression and anxiety. The platform offers psychiatric medication management, therapy, or both together. Treatment is guided by measurement-based care, meaning your progress is tracked with validated assessments. Brightside accepts many insurance plans and offers self-pay options. The platform emphasizes evidence-based treatments and regular check-ins to adjust treatment as needed.
patient_summary: Brightside combines medication and therapy for depression and anxiety. You'll get a treatment plan, regular video check-ins, and your progress is tracked so your care team knows what's working.

pricing.notes: Accepts select insurance plans. Self-pay options available starting at $95/month for medication management.

privacy.notes: HIPAA-compliant healthcare provider. Protected health information standards.

seo.title: Brightside Health: Online Psychiatry & Therapy | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Brightside Health offers online psychiatry and therapy for depression and anxiety. Medication management + therapy. Insurance accepted.

faqs.a: Brightside accepts select insurance plans including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and others. Coverage varies by state and plan. Self-pay options are also available.

faqs.q: Can I get just therapy or just medication through Brightside?
faqs.a: Yes. Brightside offers therapy-only, medication-only, or combined treatment plans. Many people benefit from both, but you can choose what works for you.
Brightside specializes in depression and anxiety, including major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, and panic disorder. They don't currently treat all mental health conditions.

faqs.q: How is Brightside different from Talkiatry?
faqs.a: Both offer online psychiatry. Brightside specializes in depression and anxiety and offers combined medication+therapy plans. Talkiatry offers psychiatry for a broader range of conditions and has wider insurance acceptance.
